day_shape: 73 items: Trump threatens 'VERY HARD' strikes on Iran and possible Kharg Island takeover before cancelling, IRGC and Defa Press warn Hormuz closure, IDF claims operational control of Wadi Saluki and 50+ Hezbollah killed, three Indian sailors die in US tanker interdiction off Oman.

threads.label: Trump strike threat and Kharg Island
threads.summary: Trump posted the US would hit Iran 'VERY HARD' overnight and may seize Kharg Island, before IRIB said the strikes were cancelled citing negotiations. Times of Israel carried expert commentary that a Kharg takeover would be quick but risky for US troops.

threads.label: Iranian threats over Hormuz and Kharg
threads.summary: IRGC Khatam al-Anbiya commander warned via Defa Press and IRIB that 'oil and gas for all or none' and that Hormuz security is at risk, while Majlis security chief Azizi said any miscalculated US move would draw a historic response. CENTCOM stated the Strait of Hormuz remains open for transit, and Hormozgan fishing authorities ordered vessels to stay within 12 nautical miles.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced operational control of the Wadi Saluki area, saying troops dismantled hundreds of structures and killed 50+ Hezbollah operatives, and signalled a coming push toward Nabatieh. A female IDF soldier was moderately injured by a Hezbollah explosive drone, and the IDF released footage from a Beaufort Ridge tunnel network.

threads.label: Iranian diplomatic and rhetorical pushback
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi told the EU foreign policy chief by phone the US bears responsibility for breaching the ceasefire, while Deputy FM Gharibabadi said military aggression cannot be legitimised by wording. IRGC spokesman Mohebbi and Quds Force commander Qaani vowed retaliation, and First VP Aref said Iran's defensive capabilities are 'leagues ahead' of two months ago.

threads.label: US sanctions, interdictions and IRGC pressure
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the US will sanction 13 individuals and entities tied to IRGC weapons procurement, and that three Indian sailors died in a US operation halting a tanker off Oman as part of a blockade of Iran-linked shipping. Iran International reported the State Department is probing NIAC founder Trita Parsi for possible green card revocation.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy and UK legislation
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the first face-to-face meeting between senior UAE and Iranian security chiefs since the war, and a Bahraini child was reportedly hurt by debris from an intercepted Iranian drone. A UK minister told Parliament new state-threat legislation could open the way to IRGC designation, and Iran and Ukraine are set to dominate the G7.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain and Afghan returns
threads.summary: Iran International reported the Majlis Research Center forecast a 13,640 MW summer power deficit, around 17% of demand, with war damage worsening shortages, and detailed a January crackdown in Nourabad Mamasani. UN OCHA via ReliefWeb said more than 1.9 million Afghans returned or were deported from Iran in 2025 after the March slip expiry.

events.title: The IDF says it killed several Hezbollah operatives who tried to flee from a major tunnel system near the Beaufort Castle in southern Lebanon. Several days ago, a drone piloted by commandos of the Egoz unit identified Hezbollah operatives inside one of the tunnel routes. events.title: War damage adds new strain to Iran’s blackout-prone power grid
